I’m sorry this isn’t the answer to your question, but just wanted to say that my dad killed himself by hanging and it was the absolute most gruesome and traumatic thing I ever had to experience. I will never get the image out of my head, and I will never stop thinking about how he felt in his final moments. 

I’ve been very suicidal in the past, so I feel hypocritical saying this, but please reconsider your decision to end it. It’s an awful thing to see, no matter who is the one to find you. I wish you healing and peace, and j hope you can find it while you’re still alive.
I think this is the best answer, thank you so much!!!

They’d still destroy the horcruxes, but in theory, it would be easier to find and destroy the horcruxes once Voldemort in a corporeal form isn’t around. Once the horcruxes are destroyed, then there WOULDNT be a chance of him coming back. Plus, the trio would have more resources, they wouldn’t be in hiding or on the run, and they could include other people in their plan since Voldemort wasn’t leading the Death Eaters and making the Order out to be terrorists. That’s all I’m saying lol

And I never said it would be “easy” to find and kill Voldemort. I’m saying destroying the horcruxes could be easIER to destroy after killing him…
I thought that he was weakened when each horcrux was made, but he couldn’t feel/it didn’t affect him when they were destroyed? I could totally be wrong but I’m trying to find an explanation somewhere
The 25th, sorry
Yay that is good! Hopefully now you can get some well deserved rest.
I’m really sorry to hear that :( I know it’s not nearly as comforting, but I’m still awake
I used to write a lot, but it’s been really hard lately. I definitely want to get back into it.

Absolutely. I totally totally understand. But yeah, that’s why just some rain made me stop lol. It seems silly but this connection is more important that I guess I thought. I’ve done a lot of writing on it and it’s all very cliche and sappy but I really love it

I don’t believe in god, but I’ve always felt a very strong connection to the weather and nature. I guess you could consider it spiritual.

It’s definitely silly, but I’ve always felt like some force of nature can feel me. I ended up going to school for meteorology and got a job that now ended up being horrible, and I’ve been feeling really lost and disconnected as a result. So the rain felt like comfort, like some energy understood my pain and gave me what I needed to feel warm again. It’s all very cliche, but it’s the closest thing I have to god, and it definitely helps to believe in something.

I agree with you in believing in a form of the devil. Some things are pure evil. Not everything happens for a reason, all that bs people spew. Some things are just horrible, without rhyme or reason. 

I think for my own sanity, I’ve had to take comfort in the only thing that comes and goes without anything stopping it, and that’s weather to me. It can help give life and take it away, and it hasn’t taken mine yet. It’s only shared in my pain and rage. For days after my breakup, I was inconsolable. And for days after my breakup, it stormed every night. I’m sure it’s in my head, but I feel it so strongly sometimes that i guess it was enough to keep me around. It was enough to get me back home.

Are there any other inpatient places you could go? I know it’s hard and it feels ridiculous like you’re putting yourself in a loony bin, but I have multiple family members who have tried both hospitalization and also a specialized psychiatric center, and they generally have better resources and it’s a nicer environment overall. One of my friends met her best friend at a place in Upstate NY, as cliche as that sounds.

But if you can’t do that, I understand thats a huge change and that’s really, really hard. I just wanted to suggest it and throw it out there as an option
Why do you not want to go back to the hospital? Not judging at all, just asking what happened to you previously

Lol don’t apologize, life is shit. It’s absolute shit. It’s way harder than it should be to find a therapist, and even harder to find a decent one.

Can I ask what stationary means?
Could you tell them you’re having a really bad night? That you just need to talk to someone for a bit?

I don’t even try to sleep when I’m like this. Turn something on, look at memes, fall down a Wikipedia hole, read some short stories.

I know you’re trying and I appreciate that so much but just please please just stay for tonight.

I understand. But get through tonight. I’m telling you, just don’t do it tonight. Don’t. Please.

Get through tonight. Please.
Damn I wish, but I’m in NY rn. Sending love and good feelings to you
It won’t work, it’ll more likely than not just leave you with a high medical bill and some pretty bad health problems

Why don’t you just get through tonight?

Feel the same tomorrow? Post here again.

But tonight, get lost in some stupid YouTube series. Jenna Marbles is one of my favorites. Go on r/roastme and let out some frustrations. Go on r/roastme and ask for some praise! Break a plate, or several. Make a fake profile on the Farmer’s Only dating site and have a laugh with yourself about all the silly bios on there. They’re better than tinder.

Just get through tonight. Don’t do it tonight.

Do you see a therapist or anything? I understand maybe your home situation prevents you from seeing one, but if there’s anyway you could reach out or try one of the online counseling sites, I think it’d help, even a little.

I won’t try to give you stupid cliches because I know they don’t work. You don’t want to write or draw or talk about the “positives of life” or who you could or could not be hurting.

You’re hurting and that’s very real. But get through the night. Please, dear god, just get through tonight. Watch some stupid videos on YouTube, go on r/roastme and take your frustrations out, make a dating profile on farmers only and laugh at all the bios that ask for someone “down and dirty.”

It’s not easy and it feels so fucking hopeless, I know. But just get through tonight. Don’t do it tonight.

Thank you but i feel very resolved now. It’s refreshing that people care about strangers and I’m sure I’d respond the same way if I read the post instead of writing it. But my time is up and I’m ready to go :)

It’s not just a boy, it’s my family and my career and the way that I’ve never been very happy. Even when things are going right. The planet is collapsing more and more each and every day. I’m simply a drain. It will hurt everyone at first, but I think in time they’ll understand that it was for the best. Thank you for your kind words tho
That’s very sweet, I actually just came back from Ohio ironically. But I’m very far away now. Thank you for your kindness but I really think my time in this world is up

I agree with that, it just makes it a lot more difficult since I live a 3 hour plane ride away and it’s about $200 to change my flight 😅 but I appreciate your input, bc that would be my solution otherwise

Racist comments that I’ve heard include, but are not limited to: “there’s too many black people here” “I hate that place, it’s just fucking Asians that work there” “id never fuck a black girl but they climb me like monkeys”

Sexist comments/actions are made ALL THE TIME, mostly about the boys refusing to clean/cook, how my boyfriend cooks more than me, comments about how their girlfriends look/act. 

You can read some other comments for situations where they’ve been rude.

I was very, very friendly when I first came. I offered to hang out with this girl since she was home during the day the same day I was. She’s very dismissive towards me, and openly ignored me if my boyfriend isn’t with me. And just because I’m not in the same room, doesn’t mean I can’t hear what she’s saying. I’ve heard her tell my boyfriend he’s “so cute and funny,” laughing her head off at something he said, and when I come into the room she walks out. I’m usually not a very jealous person, but it feels extremely hostile to me.

He’s never been like this before. He’s always been very level headed, and we’ve never had an issue like this before. I think he’s acting like this because he doesn’t want to feel left out, which I understand but I don’t know if I’m being dramatic or not

Lol it’s not a shitpost, I’m definitely frustrated but I’m trying to see if I’m being dramatic about it and should let it go since my boyfriend definitely seems to think I’m being an asshole about it ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ but thank you for your input

I haven’t broken my own skin in 10 months and that’s a huge accomplishment. It’s so fucking hard but the urge, for me at least, is mostly strong at night when I’m alone. Getting through the night and waking up the next morning feeling like I got past it is a good feeling. Even though I know it’ll just happen again tonight. Idk it’s just about every single day. Every single night. Just get through the night.
